title: Foreground Vignette
content: Golden-Age magazine illustrators came up with clever design strategies to make a composition interact with the printed page.Walter Appleton Clark(1876-1906) drew a hand-drawn rectangle for the top of the picture. Along the bottom edge, the design spills outward onto the table top, with paint strokes indicating papers and books.This design devices work well in sketchbooks, too.----Online bio aboutWalter Appleton Clarkon JVJ.
